progression.narrative: The performance opens on A#4 and dwells most on A# in Haji Hasani. The line peaks at B4 (495.6 Hz) at 0:19.1. It closes on E4, not the tonic (F#4 → D#4 → E4 → Ek4 → Ek4 → E4).
